title: The merchant’s wake

branches.condition: Wayfarer's private Trade voyage completes and Spear makes a Raid
branches.consequence: The Raid finds the Sorenne patrol. A force able to sustain combat fights and strengthens its conditioning, at a further cost to civilian life. A force too weakened to fight is disabled instead.

branches.condition: No private Trade voyage completes and Spear makes a Raid
branches.consequence: The patrol is not found. The expedition disrupts civilian traffic without sustaining the cohort through combat. Council cargo does not substitute for a commercial voyage.
These Raid consequences do not occur. Campaign and other orders have their own consequences.

guidance: Agreeing to Trade is not enough: the voyage must complete. Consider whether to offer Spear to the council, raid independently or avoid the expedition while those choices remain open.
